annotations.title: Say no to suggested recurring charges

description: Record that these merchants are not recurring bills, so the detector stops offering them — to this conversation and to every later one. A dismissal lasts until it is cleared; pass restore to clear it and let the merchant be suggested again. Writes immediately: it changes no transaction, no category and no bill.

merchants.description: Normalized merchant names, exactly as `fixed_expense_candidates` printed them.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

restore.description: Default false. True clears these dismissals instead of making them.

name: dismiss_fixed_expense_candidates
title: Say no to suggested recurring charges
